text:
THE VERSION WITH YOUR MUM ON IT (bollawave)

[Intro]
Side B. Track four.

[Verse 1]
So you got yourself a shiny box
with a million songs inside.
It guesses what you're feeling
before you've even tried.
No rewinding, no waiting,
and nothing left to hide.

[Pre-Chorus]
I'm not going to win this,
and I'm not going to try.
Let them have the perfect one —
I've got the one from that July.

[Chorus]
I'm the only copy left,
and I got it slightly wrong.
Every flaw they cleaned away
was the best part of the song.

[Verse 2]
But I kept the deejay talking,
kept your thumb that hit it late.
Kept the half a second missing
where you had to sit and wait.
Kept the kitchen, kept the kettle,
kept the rain against the gate.

[Pre-Chorus]
I'm not going to win this,
and I'm not going to try.
Let them have the perfect one —
I've got the one from that July.

[Chorus]
I'm the only copy left,
and I got it slightly wrong.
Every flaw they cleaned away
was the best part of the song.

[Bridge]
Halfway through the second chorus,
underneath the hum,
someone in the kitchen shouting:
"Dinner's ready!" — that's your mum.

[Chorus]
I'm the only copy left,
and I got it slightly wrong.
Every flaw they cleaned away
was the best part all along.

[Outro]
Your perfect copy
hasn't got your mum.
Auto-stop.
Click.

--- STYLE ---
lo-fi bedroom pop, warm melancholy, 82 BPM, rhodes electric piano, tape saturation and wow-flutter, cassette hiss, brushed drums, soft close-mic whisper vocals, one-take room sound

--- EXCLUDE ---
vinyl crackle, orchestral strings, trap hi-hats, heavy autotune
